name: Ariel Academy's Secret School Festival
summary: Ariel Academy, a relatively unassuming girls school with an annual event so outlandish that attendance might be a bucket list item for every man in the country. The Ariel Academy Culture Festival is a 2 week affair held annually in October. The general public is invited to participate not only in the traditional festivities during the day, but they're also welcome to join the students behind the curtain during the evening for the real attraction, the Backstage Culture Festival. The clubs and classes of Ariel Academy have set up all sorts of obscene versions of traditional festival staples, and some unique activities only a truly perverse group of girls could have come up with, all to help their customers make every night one to remember.​
